'''Pat Long''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 19th at [[February 2001 Meriden tournament]] on 10 February 2001 with [[Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Agents of the Black Sun]], according to Keith Henderson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1715">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-12-meriden-ct-02-10-01d1715/ meriden-ct-02-10-01], DeckTech (Keith "Tessek-CPA" Henderson, 12 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-12-meriden-ct-02-10-01d1715/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
